plugin-data.name: Redirects
plugin-data.description: Sends visitors and search engines to the right URL with a permanent 301 redirect. When you change the slug of a page the redirect from the old URL is created for you.

redirects-tip: One redirect per line, the old path and the new path or full URL separated by a space. Redirects to a redirect are resolved when you save, and loops are removed. A published page in the old path wins over the redirect.
redirects-rejected: These lines were not saved, each line needs an old path of this site and a new path or full URL:
